label: Terrace tending

license.author: NemoWorld project contributors
license.source: Original NemoWorld authored content: the activity manifests in src/content-manifest.js
license.note: Authored for this project; no third-party asset was copied. An activity is a deterministic schedule, not an implemented simulation loop. The repository carries no LICENSE file, so redistribution terms are unstated. See content/THIRD_PARTY.md.

rules.clock: tick indices counted from the world boot; no wall-clock time, no date and no random draw is read, so two runs of the same world produce the same schedule
rules.implements: the living-world resident loop (src/living-world.js) and the venue machinery the place names; this definition records the schedule the loop is expected to keep and is not yet read by it

notes: A steward walks the three retaining edges and tends the beds between them. No crop is harmed and no window is missed: the definition records a schedule, not a failure state.
